description: A utility class for interacting with a local checkout of the Web Platform Tests, including methods for fetching, cleaning, creating branches, testing patches, and finding recent commits.

classes.name: LocalWPT
classes.description: A class providing utilities to manage and interact with a local Web Platform Tests repository, including fetching updates, creating branches with patches, testing patches, and retrieving commit information.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LocalWPT object with host, optional GitHub token, and repository path.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the latest updates from the remote WPT repository, cloning if necessary.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command in the local WPT directory.

methods.name: most_recent_chromium_commit
methods.description: Finds the most recent commit in WPT with a Chromium commit position.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Resets the repository to a clean state, checking out master branch.

methods.name: all_branches
methods.description: Returns a list of all local and remote branches.

methods.name: create_branch_with_patch
methods.description: Creates a new branch, applies a patch, commits, and pushes it.

methods.name: test_patch
methods.description: Tests a patch against origin/master and returns the diff output.

methods.name: commits_behind_master
methods.description: Returns the number of commits behind origin/master from a given commit.
